resources.string: Lets Kivo read the screen and tap for you

When enabled, Kivo reads what is on screen (text, buttons, menus) and can tap, type, scroll or go back for you when you ask.

• It never reads password fields and does not work on PIN/OTP screens or system permission dialogs.
• Sending messages, buying, paying or deleting always asks you first.
• Tap the floating orb while it works to stop it at once. You can turn this service off at any time.
• Screen data is sent to the AI provider you chose only while you are using Kivo.
